title: Values and Principles
text:
Expertise
Our biggest asset is our people. We encourage our team to rapidly acquire and internalize the domain knowledge in every niche field of service. We strive to create and foster a productive learning environment, in which the practical application of rules and procedures is given a premium over simply studying the theory.
We know the difference between experience and expertise. While most of our competitors may emphasize their decades of experience, they actually rely on an outmoded set of rules.
Therefore, their so-called "experience" actually hinders real progress as they tend to stick to what they "know". Knowing how things worked before is not enough to bring value in the 21st century.
Our starting point is to recognize that we do not know everything, but we will experiment and apply ourselves to find the best solutions and the most accurate answers. As true innovators of our industry, we actively seek additional knowledge and skills to respond to the changing regulatory landscape.
As a result, we develop unmatched expertise in all areas of service.
Innovation
Innovation is what has defined our company since its inception. We think about process improvement every day. We invest heavily in technology and automation.
Not only do we innovate in making our clients experience better, but also by building time-saving and value-enhancing tools for our team internally. Unlike our competitors, who use pre-packaged technical and data solutions, we have developed our own client relationship management systems from scratch. Our innovation efforts permeate the business development efforts as we seek to serve our clients in new and better ways. For example, each year we experiment with adding at least one new service (revenue stream) to our existing line up of services. Sometimes, these new offerings do not scale, and we have to quickly pivot away into different business lines. Sometimes, the new offerings turn into self-sufficient income-producing business units (e.g., Affordable Housing Unit).
As a result of our focus on innovation our clients utilize the online portal, which allows for streamlined data collection and more efficient communication channels. We provide regular updates and reports filled with relevant actionable data. Our team is equipped with the best tools to perform their daily tasks, and our leadership seeks new opportunities to invest in technology
Transparency
We strive to offer our clients direct visibility into all of the processes relevant to their project. We accomplish this by regular status updates and customized reporting. Unlike many of our competitors, we do not obscure the full picture. Instead, we help our clients clearly understand the implications of our actions and their decisions.
For example, when a client is considering participation in a particular tax benefit program, we advise on all costs - including costs of compliance and opportunity costs - of both participating and not participating in the program. When a client wants to assess whether a certain filing is necessary, we go out of our way to explain all the cons and pros.
When the government agencies hide the facts out of convenience and other service providers obscure the truth for personal gains, we expose the data entirely for the benefit of our clients.
Breadth
We pride ourselves in offering the full spectrum of relevant tax advisory services. Since there isn't a single best way to optimize property taxes, we identify appropriate opportunities by tapping into our knowledge and expertise in multiple domains. We provide annual compliance and appeal services, file applications for project-based exemptions and abatements, help clients maintain the long-term tax benefits, offer tax projections and opinions, market and lease affordable units, among other relevant services. By offering a wide range of services, we can cover all of our clients' needs.
Our goal is to continually expand our service offerings by adding more value to our clients and more opportunities for our team's professional development.
Fairness
When it comes to tax assessment reductions, most taxpayers have been enduring a decades-long practice of being charged contingency fees they don't fully understand. We reject the standard billing practice of charging a fee based on hypothetical future savings. Instead, our fee is based on the real tangible benefit that our clients realize an immediate result of our efforts.
In all other business units, we charge either flat fees or reasonable milestone-based fees upon delivery of certain agreed upon results.
By not focusing on the short term self-benefit, we allow our customers to thrive and enjoy repeat business and referrals from most of them.
Client Amazement
We design all of our communications and processes with the goal of amazing our clients. We strive to achieve excellence in the delivery of our services and in customer support. By nurturing relationships with our clients, we establish the level of trust required for securing high-value projects.
If we are unable to support a particular client, the principle of Client Amazement requires that we no longer do business together. Our commitment and efforts can only go so far. That is why we do not tolerate clients who exude pettiness, unjustified rudeness, unrealistic expectations, or tend to engage in unethical business practices.
When we align ourselves with the best companies in the real estate industry, our team feels empowered to deliver the best customer service.
The Long View
The actions we take and the results we achieve do not occur in a vacuum.
We understand that the world of real estate has an enormous impact on the ecosystem of the City. Our careful approach to work ensures that we not only touch our clients in meaningful ways, but also have an indirect impact on the City and State agencies, the small businesses as well as families all throughout the City.
When faced with difficult challenges, we work closely on policy and procedure with the government agencies, encouraging them to implement recommended improvements. We are sensitive to our clients' business relationships with their own stakeholders and encourage them to take a long view in the decisions they make.
